page.overview:
What is Maglor?

Maglor was the second son of Fëanor and Nerdanel. He was the greatest poet and minstrel of the Ñoldor and was said to have inherited his mother's gentler temperament.

Among the seven brothers, only Maglor, Caranthir, and Curufin were married, but nothing is told of their wives.

Maglor was born in Eldamar during the Noontide of Valinor in the First Age.

As with the other Sons of Fëanor, Maglor was bound by an oath to recover his father's Silmarils, stolen by the Dark Lord Morgoth. This oath took the seven brothers to Middle-earth during the late First Age where they established realms in exile, waged war against the armies of Morgoth, fought their own Elven kind, and eventually brought ruin upon themselves.
